faq.q: Which is more expensive, braces or clear aligners?
faq.a: You may be wondering which is more expensive: braces or aligners? Although some orthodontic techniques and treatments can be quite costly, the average price of traditional braces is usually higher than that of invisible aligners. However, bear in mind that the final cost of your orthodontic treatment will depend on several factors, such as the severity of your case, the type of braces or aligners you choose and the length of your treatment.

faq.q: Which is better, invisible orthodontics or braces?
faq.a: It is a question orthodontists hear often: which is better, invisible orthodontics or braces? In terms of effectiveness, both treatments work. However, a professional orthodontist should recommend one or the other for each patient. Invisible orthodontics is usually recommended for mild and moderate cases, while braces are useful in more severe cases.

faq.q: What happens if you don't wear your aligners for 22 hours a day?
faq.a: Because aligners are removed, they do not act on your teeth while they are not being worn. So they must be worn for the number of hours a day prescribed by the orthodontist.

texto: Clínica Dental Ontiveros specialises in comprehensive dental treatment. Located in Marbella, in the heart of the Costa del Sol, it opened its doors in 2001 and since then its highest aim has been patient satisfaction.
quienes.valores_title: What can you expect from us?

valores.texto: A team of specialists in every area of dentistry who guarantee the best care for your dental health.
We adapt to your needs and look for the best option for you; honesty is our hallmark.
Multiple treatment alternatives. New techniques appear every day and we are committed to offering them to you.
A different kind of clinic, with a comfortable, relaxed atmosphere that makes visiting your dentist a more positive experience.

queremos: We want to be a reference for those looking for professionalism and a personal touch.
We want to focus on prevention, that is, acting before problems appear.
We want to always offer you the latest technological advances, which is why our professionals are in continuous training.
We want our patients' satisfaction to be our best guarantee.

instalaciones.seo_desc: Facilities at Clínica Dental Ontiveros in Marbella: waiting room, three treatment rooms, full sterilisation and a digital panoramic X-ray unit.
bloques: Our new facilities have been specially designed to offer you maximum comfort and, above all, to stimulate your senses.
The refurbished decor is an explosion of colours and images that makes you forget for a moment that you are in a dental clinic.
The clinic has a welcoming, spacious waiting room and three large treatment rooms.
The clinic has a comprehensive disinfection and sterilisation system that guarantees protection against diseases transmitted through blood and saliva (HIV, hepatitis, herpes…):
ultrasonic cleaning, drying, bagging and sealing of instruments before sterilisation in an autoclave.
We have a digital orthopantomograph for panoramic X-rays, which give more detailed information about the general condition of the mouth. This equipment has several advantages:

lista: Being digital, it saves a great deal of time, as no developing is needed
It considerably reduces the patient's exposure to X-rays.

tratamientos.seo_title: Dental treatments in Marbella | Clínica Dental Ontiveros
tratamientos.seo_desc: Invisible orthodontics, implants, cosmetic dentistry, whitening, periodontics, prosthetics, surgery, TMJ and general dentistry in Marbella. Free first visit.
tratamientos.intro: At Clínica Dental Ontiveros we offer the following treatments:

bloques: Invisible orthodontics is a treatment that moves teeth into the correct position using clear, almost invisible aligners. Their main advantage is that they are removable and custom-made for any type of patient. Treatment starts with a set of aligners that is changed progressively so that the teeth move gradually into place; being removable, they are far more comfortable than traditional braces. Invisible orthodontics without brackets is very comfortable, removable and transparent, so patients no longer have to put up with traditional braces. Ask about invisible orthodontic treatment at Clínica Dental Ontiveros.
Through an appropriate diagnostic phase we can determine the specific needs of your mouth in order to carry out the most suitable individual treatment plan.
Conservative treatments repair damage in the mouth through fillings, root canals and cleanings, keeping your teeth healthy and attractive for many years and avoiding more invasive procedures.
The keys to good oral health are:

lista: Prevention
Regular check-ups with a professional
Good hygiene habits

bloques: Surgery is possibly the dental speciality that raises the most fears and questions. At Clínica Dental Ontiveros we are proud to have Juan Manuel Blasco, a highly regarded surgeon who will explain the details of the procedure and answer any questions you may have.
Our maxillofacial surgeon treats a wide range of problems: impacted teeth, cysts, apicoectomies, flaps, sinus lifts with bone grafts, and extraction of impacted and erupted wisdom teeth.
Each operation is followed up afterwards to guarantee our patients' safety and peace of mind.

This area of dentistry is one of those that has advanced the most in recent years. It is no longer just about solving a problem or replacing teeth; it is about giving our patients back their best smile, which we achieve with techniques such as the mock-up, a preview of how your smile will look before treatment begins, which is very motivating for the patient.

The aim of cosmetic dentistry is a natural look, so that dental work looks as natural as possible. With materials such as zirconia, new porcelains and innovative tooth whitening treatments, we improve the appearance of your smile.
Electroformed GOLD crowns offer excellent aesthetics and, thanks to the properties of gold, a better long-term prognosis for preserving the prepared teeth.

lista.subtitulo: New ways to achieve the smile you have always wanted
bloques: Orthodontics is the dental speciality concerned with the diagnosis, prevention and treatment of misaligned teeth and jaw deformities.

When the teeth do not fit together correctly there is a malocclusion, which not only affects the look of your smile and mouth but also makes oral hygiene harder, causing tooth decay, gum problems and bad breath.
Clínica Dental Dr. Ontiveros stands out for being at the forefront of new dental techniques and equipment, so we can offer our patients the latest procedures, such as:
The Damon System uses self-ligating brackets that, combined with high-tech alloy archwires, apply light forces so that tooth movement is faster and more comfortable.

lista: Treatment without tooth extractions.
More comfortable tooth movement. A passive ligation system avoids excessive forces that could cause discomfort.
Faster tooth movement.
Shorter appointments.
Fewer surgical cases.
Improved facial aesthetics. It enhances the face by giving more natural support to the soft tissues of the lower third of the face, without cosmetic surgery.

bloques: Damon orthodontics also offers Damon Clear, transparent brackets that do not discolour or stain.

All these treatments are always supported by the latest advances in dental technology and equipment, adapted to each patient's needs, as is the case with digital radiovisiography. This technique has several advantages:

lista: It saves you the time and effort of going elsewhere for a general X-ray to obtain a proper diagnosis.
Its X-ray system emits less radiation, which is therefore less harmful to your health, as the radiation we receive over our lifetime is cumulative.

bloques: Tooth whitening is a non-abrasive cosmetic treatment that leaves teeth whiter, brighter and healthier. We use a product that works through oxygen, lightening the tooth by several shades within its own colour. It also removes stains caused by food, drinks (coffee, tea, red wine) and certain medicines.
Whitening does not cause abrasion (wear) of the teeth, and it is not possible to whiten existing fillings, veneers, crowns or bridges.
Results depend on each patient and their particular tooth colour, which the specialist will assess beforehand.

For faster and more effective treatment we use an LED whitening lamp. It whitens in a single one-hour session with less discomfort, as it treats both arches (upper and lower) at the same time, so the patient does not have to keep their mouth open for as long.
Periodontics treats the tissue that surrounds the tooth and attaches it to the bone. When this tissue becomes diseased it causes:

lista: GINGIVITIS: red, bleeding gums; only the gum is affected.
PERIODONTITIS: may be due to genetic or environmental factors and is more serious because teeth may be lost.

bloques: Before starting treatment it is important to make a good clinical diagnosis to determine how severe the problem is and how to treat it.
In more advanced cases, where a cleaning is not enough, periodontal scaling and root planing is needed and sometimes periodontal surgery.

Prevention is essential to have and keep a healthy mouth, which is why preventive measures are recommended: dental cleanings at least once a year, pit and fissure sealants on healthy teeth to make children's brushing more effective, fluoride treatments…
It is also important to know the correct brushing techniques since, as a short test can show, most of us neither know nor practise them.

Implantology is currently the fastest-growing technique in dentistry. Dental implants solve situations that were unthinkable only a few years ago. The way we replace teeth has changed: implants are a major advance because missing teeth can be replaced without touching the neighbouring teeth.

As well as single teeth, implant-supported bridges can be made when there is a larger gap, and overdentures anchored on two, four or six implants (depending on the amount of bone). Although in this last case the denture is still removable, it gives much more security and comfort: it does not move and you can bite with more force.
Our aim is our patients' satisfaction, which is why we offer the latest techniques for replacing teeth, both fixed and removable prostheses.
FIXED PROSTHESES: porcelain fused to metal.
REMOVABLE PROSTHESES: removable appliances in precious metals, or in resin when a metal one is not possible, for edentulous patients (with no teeth).

COMBINED PROSTHESES: a removable metal prosthesis combined with porcelain-fused-to-metal crowns fitted with attachments that clip into them, replacing the unsightly metal clasps of removable appliances. This looks more natural, as there are no visible clasps to give away that it is a prosthesis.

Some people clench their teeth tightly at night, sometimes because of bad habits and sometimes because of stress built up during the day. This habit causes constant tension in the jaw muscles, which ends up causing pain and discomfort as well as tooth wear. For these people, known as bruxists, there are muscle relaxation splints to wear while sleeping.
To diagnose the exact nature of the problem it is usually necessary to use articulated models of the mouth, different types of X-rays, occlusion analysis software, etc.

The way the teeth come into contact can cause discomfort, especially when opening and closing the mouth, because one side is overloaded more than the other. The longer the problem has lasted, the harder it is to treat.

faq.q: What does treatment for bruxism and TMJ involve?
faq.a: Successful treatment means restoring the balance between the muscles, teeth and joints. To do this we use orthopaedic, orthodontic and prosthetic techniques and different types of occlusal splints.

faq.q: What are snoring and sleep apnoea?
faq.a: When we sleep, the muscles and tissues of the throat and mouth relax automatically. The jaw and tongue fall back, narrowing the airway between them. The sound of snoring is actually the sound of vibrating tissue.

Treatment usually consists of acrylic appliances worn in the mouth at night, which prevent the problem while they are worn and can be used for life. The special splint creates more space so that air flows freely and the tissue vibration is reduced or stops. The splint is comfortable and only worn while sleeping.
